Medical Coding Services

A code has to tell the same story as the chart. We assign codes from your documentation, flag gaps for your providers, and give you feedback you can use.

Contact UsCall us

How coding problems cost you

Undercoding

Cautious coding can leave earned revenue unbilled, and the loss rarely shows up on any report.

Overcoding and audit exposure

Codes the documentation cannot support create repayment risk long after the claim has paid.

Modifier and bundling errors

A missing or misused modifier can trigger a denial, or pay a service that should have been bundled.

What is included

  • CPT, ICD-10-CM and HCPCS Level II code assignment
  • Modifier review
  • NCCI edit checks
  • Evaluation and management level review
  • Documentation queries to providers
  • Retrospective coding audits
  • Audit findings with provider-level feedback

Scope is confirmed for each client during the assessment.

How we work

  1. Sample your charts

    We review a sample of encounters against the codes that were billed.

  2. Share what we find

    You get the patterns, the affected codes and the documentation gaps in plain language.

  3. Code or coach

    We take over daily coding, or keep the work with your team and audit it on a schedule.
